central_idea_and_construction: One compact paper-fan signature for a collage app, made from exactly three large flat paper-petal pieces growing from a common low base. Each piece uses the same rule: a broad rounded top and a gently tapered body with a blunt base. Left pink piece tilts left and is medium height; center golden-orange piece stands tallest; right cobalt piece tilts right and is shorter and wider. Let them overlap only at the broad common base, with clean purposeful junctions; no thin white channel or bent tubular stroke. The overall silhouette is an asymmetric fan, not a flower with a stem, a hand, a star or scattered confetti. Color has a clear role on each piece and never becomes random fragmented patchwork. Flat crisp fills with no texture, shading or translucent effects. Entire mark fills72% width and64% height. A pale lemon background fills the square edge-to-edge; no inner rounded tile or frame.
small_size_signature: Three broad differently oriented petals and their single compact fan silhouette.
specific_risk: Overlap can hide the common construction or create hand-like extra fingers.
